mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates labor market weakness and reduced consumer spending, depressing corporate earnings and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE is above 7.0%, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A one-month increase in the federal funds rate above 0.1 percentage points signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp in 1 month, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1400.0 thousand units over two months signals weakening consumer demand and reduced economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST falls below 1400.0 in 2 months, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and decrease in housing starts (HOUST) indicates a supply-demand mismatch where production growth lacks consumer support, signaling economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO rises and HOUST falls, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates broad consumer spending contraction across sectors, amplifying negative impacts on corporate earnings and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment phases (UNRATE > 6.5%), labor market weakness reduces consumer spending and corporate profit growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 6.5%, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A one-month increase in the consumer price index above 0.2 percentage points signals accelerating inflation, prompting Federal Reserve tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.2pp in 1 month, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.
